authorization: User requested the attached adaptive peak-spin campaign and selected: Keep the original start and diagnose it.
starting_field: Exact supplied matched-stretch construction. Preserve its raw periodic-join mismatch and mean; no smoothing repair or energy rescaling.
equation: Unforced periodic Navier-Stokes; original Heun, Fourier projection and filter.
phase: Apply stopping rules to original initial fields and already saved trajectories before longer evolution.
high_band: At least one retained component index >= 0.8 floor(N/3), as in the fixed study.
comparison: Only common saved time interval. 112 has initialization only if the initial gate fails; no fabricated 112 trajectory.
mechanism: Colocated signed vorticity stretching, transport and viscosity at each saved global maximum; strain eigenvector alignment with degeneracy flag.
profiles: Minimum transverse half-peak chord in 12 directions using periodic trilinear interpolation. Normalize by measured half-width and peak magnitude; interpolation is not added resolution.
local_maxima: Detect all maxima at the saved cadence. Unsaved within-step maxima cannot be recovered from the archived fields.
longer_time_rule: No adaptive extension from a state failing any resolution gate. Existing separately authorized fixed matrices continue as unresolved diagnostics.
parameter_and_geometric_ensemble: A longer normalized parameter campaign is held at this initial resolution gate. Existing viscosity, amplitude, angle and seeded perturbation controls are inventoried. Do not silently normalize or replace the original field.
classification: Report resolved, transient, unresolved, or numerical-candidate only when corresponding tests support it. No singular-time fit is interpreted from an unresolved interval.
